theThirdRowTheDispatchDidNotKnowAbout.owner_name: G-154 lane verification (machine credential, not a person)
theThirdRowTheDispatchDidNotKnowAbout.reading: Minted 6 minutes before this CP1 ran, and its last_used_at is 23 SECONDS before this CP1 ran. The in-flight G-154 lane is holding a verification-scoped bastrop_tx credential and is using it right now. The dispatch's central premise — that no lane-usable credential exists — was true when the dispatch was compiled and was false before this lane read it.

theSecondRow.reading: A lane-verification key minted three days ago by the G-134 lane. Its last_used_at is 14 seconds after creation, so it was minted, exercised once, and never used again. It was invisible to the 2026-09-15 G-135 lane, to this dispatch, and to _catalog/credential_access_index.json.

CONTRADICTION_theDispatchPremiseIsStale.whyThisDoesNotStopTheWork: The dispatch's completion predicate is a DOCUMENTED location a lane can obtain a credential from without asking a human, and no such location exists: there is no Secret Manager secret holding any bastrop_tx lane credential in hauska-prod-497015 (verified by `gcloud secrets list`), and credential_access_index.json still reads 'REQUESTED, NOT YET MINTED'. Two ad-hoc keys existing does not satisfy it. Minting the named secret is still the missing deliverable.
CONTRADICTION_theDispatchPremiseIsStale.whatItDoesChange: (1) The value of the mint is DEDUPLICATION plus documentation, not first provisioning. (2) Four bastrop_tx keys will exist if this lane mints; the three above (two of them ad-hoc lane keys with no recorded location) plus the new one. The planner should decide whether to revoke the two ad-hoc lane keys, and this lane does not revoke them unilaterally — the G-154 one is in use this minute by a lane that is still executing. (3) credential_access_index.json's 'status: REQUESTED, NOT YET MINTED' was already stale before this lane started.

whatWasNotDone: No hash, no raw key, and no key value of any kind was selected, printed or written. The response shape has no hash at all.
The pilot row was READ and not touched. No PATCH, no revoke, no status change on any existing row.
